text:
Maya (AE): Acme Security requests our SOC 2 report, NDA, and a bridge letter for their vendor review. They want everything this week.
Ben (InfoSec): We can share the hosted SOC 2 Type II now. Private deployment attestation is still in progress. We should prepare a measured bridge letter. :memo:
Carla (Legal): I have a mutual NDA template ready. Send me the signatory name and entity so I can prepare DocuSign.
Dae (SolutionsEng): They also want a short architecture sketch and a control-to-SIG mapping. I can pull encryption, KMS, and access control details.
Maya (AE): Contact is security@acme-co.com, signatory Jordan Lee (Dir, Procurement). They prefer a CISO-level signatory on the bridge letter.
Ben (InfoSec): I'll draft the bridge wording to: reference the hosted SOC 2, note Private audit is "in progress" with ETA, list compensating controls (encryption in transit/at rest, KMS, RBAC, IR). Avoid absolute guarantees.
Carla (Legal): I'll add confidentiality checkbox in DocuSign for audit artifacts and handle signature delegation.
Acme Security Bot: Automated checklist received: SOC 2 link + completed SIG/CAIQ recommended.
Maya (AE): Plan: 1) Get NDA signed 2) share redacted hosted SOC 2 link 3) provide bridge letter draft and diagrams. Will push Acme for quick turnaround.
Dae (SolutionsEng): Action: produce architecture diagram, SIG mapping CSV, redact pen-test summary. ETA 3 business days.
Ben (InfoSec): Action: draft bridge letter by EOD tomorrow, prepare redacted SOC 2 PDF, and a 1-page risk summary.
Carla (Legal): Action: send NDA today via DocuSign. Review bridge wording after Ben's draft.
Maya (AE): I'll upload the SOC 2 to secure share after NDA and notify security@acme-co.com. If they insist on a CISO signature, Ben can co-sign.
Ben (InfoSec): Also will include standard non-distribution clause for audit artifacts.
Maya (AE): Target: NDA signed and SOC 2 link shared within 48 hours; bridge-letter draft in 72 hours. Will update CRM and follow up with Acme for any exec call.
Carla (Legal): Sounds good.
Maya (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup:
